summary: Retested theme/font-size regression + new light-mode remap for previously dark-by-design pages. All 8 feature checks pass, including the font-size outside-click dismissal that was broken in iteration_50. Dark-by-design pages (Home hero, Pricing, Plant Database, /app workspace) now correctly flip to light in light mode and back to dark in dark mode. Theme persists via localStorage across navigation and reload. Workspace /app renders in the current theme on both light and dark. One UX gap noted: the SiteHeader (and therefore the theme/font-size toggles) is NOT rendered inside the /app workspace — users must navigate back to a public page to change theme while signed in.

issues: The three glassmorphic cards (Student, Starter, Professional) have very low-contrast title/price text against the dark navy background in dark mode — e.g. 'Student', '15', '₹99', '30', '₹250', '100', '₹1,000', 'Professional' are barely visible. The 'Research' card is readable only because it has a cream/beige highlight background. Appears pre-existing (not caused by this iteration), but still worth fixing — consider raising the plan title and price colors to a lighter ink (e.g. #E7E7F3 or white) in dark mode.

Theme toggle and font-size toggle are NOT available in the workspace top bar — the workspace uses its own header without SiteHeader. Theme still applies correctly (via <html data-theme>), but a signed-in user cannot change theme/font-size without leaving /app. Consider adding theme-toggle + font-size-toggle to the workspace header.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Improve contrast of plan title/price text on /pricing dark-mode cards — pre-existing low contrast on Student/Starter/Professional cards.
(Optional, UX) Add theme-toggle + font-size-toggle to the /app workspace header so signed-in users can change theme/font without leaving the workspace.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext.jsx and SiteHeader.jsx outside-click fix (document-level mousedown listener with ref check) works as intended — no more overlay blocking page interactions, menu reliably closes on outside click. Clean implementation.

index.css dark→light remap block for pages like Pricing/Plant-DB/Home is doing a lot of heavy per-class overrides (bg-[#0F0E24], bg-[#0B0918], text-slate-*, border-white/*, etc.). This is pragmatic but fragile — new dark-authored classes added later will not automatically flip to light. Longer-term fix: refactor those pages to use theme-aware tokens instead of hardcoded hex/slate utilities.
Pre-existing hydration warning on /plant-database remains (<span> inside <option> at pages/PlantDatabase/index.jsx:917-918 via x-dynamic wrapper). Unrelated to theme work.
